paragraphs: Yet another weather app — but the background is a live 3D sky computed from the forecast: volumetric clouds from the model's cloud layers and atmosphere, real sun and moon positions, rain, snow, hail, lightning and frost on the glass. Liquid-glass UI that adapts to how bright the sky is.
features: City search — worldwide geocoding with result ranking (capitals and large cities preferred) and browser-language + English fallback, so names like "Warszawa" or "Waszyngton" resolve correctly
Geolocation — weather for your current location via the browser Geolocation API
Map picker — resizable drawer with a Leaflet/OpenStreetMap map; click to pick a point, confirm to load it

Current conditions — temperature, feels like, min/max, wind, pressure, humidity, visibility, cloud cover, UV, precipitation, dew point, and the sun (or moon) arc between sunrise and sunset, all in the location's time…

whatItDoes.text: Yet another weather app — but the background is a live 3D sky computed from the forecast: volumetric clouds from the model's cloud layers and atmosphere, real sun and moon positions, rain, snow, hail, lightning and frost on the glass. Liquid-glass UI that adapts to how bright the sky is.

requirements.text: This app uses the Open-Meteo API — a free, open-source weather API that requires no API key or registration.
